title: Shrimp Linguine with Lime, Jalapeño and Herbs
changes_from_base: Prawns poached in the starchy pasta water with red pepper, jalapeño and lime, finished with parsley, coriander and Parmesan instead of a tomato sauce.
summary: Linguine with tender prawns poached in starchy pasta water with red pepper, jalapeño and lime, finished with fresh herbs and Parmesan.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.8%)
ingredients.note: about 4 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan over medium heat and cook the red pepper and onion for 6-8 min until tender. Stir in the garlic, jalapeño, lime juice, salt and pepper and cook 1 min more.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the linguine in 3 litres salted water until al dente. Save about 250 ml of the water, then drain.

steps.title: Poach the prawns
steps.text: Pour the saved water over the vegetables, bring to a boil and add the prawns. Cook 2-3 min, stirring, until pink and opaque all through (63 °C); the starchy water becomes a light sauce as it reduces.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the linguine, parsley and coriander and toss for 30 s. Divide between plates and grate Parmesan over each.

tips: Pull the prawns as soon as they turn opaque, as they toughen fast.
Seed the jalapeño for a milder dish.
Frozen raw prawns work well; thaw them in the fridge first.
storage: Best eaten straight away. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day, reheating until piping hot (74 °C).
